rag.text:
Test: TC-5952 — SPM - Strategic areas - Share option
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/TS-519 Strategic Areas
Labels: spm-paulina-tc

Description:
User is logged on his Jira account

[testlab.1@softwareplant.com|mailto:testlab.1@softwareplant.com] is secondary account

Steps:
1. Navigate to OKR module of ROOT (Main) box
   Expected: OKR module is displayed
2. Click on Add button
   Expected: Following options are displayed:

* Create objective
* Create strategic theme
* Link to box (grayed out)
3. Click Create and select Strategic Theme
   Expected: New Strategic theme modal is displayed
4. Type strategicThemeName, select period and click Create
   Data: strategicThemeName: TC-5952

period: Y2026
   Expected: Strategic Theme is created and Tree view is displayed

Plus button is displayed next to Strategic Theme
5. Click on Plus button next to Strategic Theme, add newObjective and period
   Data: newObjective: TC-5952 A

period: Q12026
   Expected: New Objective TC-5952 A is created under Strategic Theme TC-5952.
6. Click on Plus button next to TC-5952 A objective, add keyResult with period
   Data: keyResult: TC-5952 B

period: Y2026
   Expected: New Key Result TC-5952 B is created under Objective TC-5952 A
7. Click Finish & go back
   Expected: Strategic Theme TC-5952 is displayed on the list with expand button next to it
8. Click Strategic Areas on the left panel (above Settings)
   Expected: List of Strategic themes is displayed
9. Click on strategicThemeName
   Data: strategicThemeName: TC-5952
   Expected: OKRs tab is displayed with following OKRs:

* Strategic Theme: TC-5952
* Objective: TC-5952 A
* Key result:  TC-5952 B

Widgets on the left shows

* Strategic Theme: 1
* Objectives: 1
* Key results: 1
10. Click on period filter
   Data: period: Q1 Y2026
   Expected: OKRs tab is displayed with following OKRs:

* Strategic Theme: TC-5952 (grayed out)
* Objective: TC-5952 A 
* Key result: TC-5952 B (grayed out)

Widgets on the left shows

* Strategic Theme: 0
* Objectives: 1
* Key results: 0

Information Filter "List is limited by filters. To display all existing initiatives" is displayed
11. Click on Share button{color:#ffffff}Copy URL to clipboard{color}
   Expected: Share view modal is disaplayed with information: 

By copying the link, you can easily share the current view with your team.

‘Get Help’ button is displayed and ‘Copy URL to clipboard’ buttons are displayed

{color:#ffffff}Copy URL to clipboard{color}
12. Click on Get Help button
   Expected: New tab is opened with link directing to [https://appfire.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SPM/pages/2325217590/Strategic+Areas?platform=JiraCloud|https://appfire.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SPM/pages/2325217590/Strategic+Areas?platform=JiraCloud]
13. Go back to pervious tab and click on ‘Copy URL to clipboard’ button
   Expected: Button changed to green 

"URL copied to clipboard"
14. Log as testlab.1@softwareplant.com
   Expected: 
15. In new tab, paste link
   Expected: Period filter Q1 Y2026 is selected

OKRs tab is displayed with following OKRs:

* Strategic Theme: TC-5952 (grayed out)
* Objective: TC-5952 A
* Key result: TC-5952 B (grayed out)

Widgets on the left shows

* Strategic Theme: 0
* Objectives: 1
* Key results: 0

Information Filter "List is limited by filters. To display all existing initiatives" is displayed
